The commits show the edit; not deployment."]},"linkedin":{"text":"A portfolio rebuild is mostly an editing exercise.
I started from the earlier Observatory version of my portfolio and rebuilt it around the Cosmos design. The old version had separate project, research, contact, and lab routes. The rebuild removes that structure and adds a Cosmos page alongside a simpler résumé mode.

The next commits were small but practical: I added Cloudflare deployment configuration, changed the heading font from Syne to Archivo, linked the thesis to its GitHub repository, and linked the résumé on GitHub. I also refreshed several work descriptions.

One decision I like is the one that looks least additive: removing Fibly from the site. That keeps the portfolio closer to what I want to present now, instead of treating every previous entry as permanent.

The history is compact—most of the work landed between November 1 and 2. I’m describing the repository changes here, not claiming a live deployment or runtime behavior that the commit records do not establish."},"highlights":["602435b — Added the earlier Observatory portfolio version.","f520517 — Rebuilt the portfolio around the Cosmos design.","bb7f683 — Linked the thesis to its GitHub repository.","c1bb84b — Added Cloudflare deployment configuration.","54d8361 — Switched the heading font from Syne to Archivo.","0bf80ab — Linked the résumé on GitHub and refreshed work descriptions.","2646d99 — Removed Fibly from the site."],"claims_to_verify":["Whether the current site builds, passes browser tests, or is live on Cloudflare is not established by the supplied commit history."]}
